tex_content.html:
Definition

For an open cover $\mathcal X=(X_\alpha )_{\alpha \in A}$ of a topological space $M$, a partition of unity subordinate to $\mathcal X$ is a family of continuous functions $\psi _\alpha :M\to \mathbb R$ satisfying \[ 0\leq \psi _\alpha \leq 1,\qquad \operatorname {supp}\psi _\alpha \subseteq X_\alpha , \] with locally finite supports and $\sum _{\alpha \in A}\psi _\alpha (x)=1$ for every $x$. Local finiteness makes the sum locally finite. It is smooth when every $\psi _\alpha $ is smooth.
